new_candidates.requirement: Update the existing XInclude allocation-failure check to use the error state written by the changed memory-error path.
new_candidates.target_route: A framed main entity with a nonnull URL is parsed into a document. The target creates xinc, calls xmlXIncludeProcessNode, then checks xmlXIncludeGetLastError(xinc). ProcessNode calls xmlXIncludeDoProcessRoot, which duplicates the document URL before processing includes.
new_candidates.failure_condition: Select the input-controlled allocation limit to fail the root processor's URL duplication after context creation. The changed xmlXIncludeErrMemory updates the global error but passes no context error structure and does not set xinc->errNo. The root processor returns immediately. The target's existing check sees fuzzAllocFailed true and xmlXIncludeGetLastError(xinc) unequal to XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY, so xmlFuzzCheckMallocFailure aborts.
new_candidates.alternative_paths: The root processor returns before later XInclude error handling can update xinc->errNo. The global error is updated, but this assertion does not read it. A null xinc would satisfy the assertion, whereas this witness requires the already-created nonnull context.
